en: Black‑and‑white view of a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century railway station complex with a central clock‑tower entrance, flanked by two similar two‑story buildings. In front are cobblestone streets with tram tracks curving past electric poles, and several streetcars at a small tram stop. People stand near the station and walk in a landscaped park area with young trees and bushes in the foreground. There is a cylindrical advertising column near the entrance. The overall look is that of a European town's main station square. No legible printed caption or handwriting is visible in this image.
